To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cardiovascular effects (pressor) of blockade of GABAA receptors in the horizontal limb (HDB) are dependent on the glutamatergic activation of NMDA and AMPA receptors.
the GABAergic system of the hDB is tonically inhibiting the cardiovascular effects of glutaminergic system in the hDB.
The cardiovascular effects of blockade in GABAergic inhibition of the hDB are modulated by the glutaminergic system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction of GABAergic and the glutaminergic systems in the hDB of anesthetized rats.
the interaction between GABAergic and Glutaminergic neurons in the hDB and their possible role in cardiovascular regulation.
the interaction of GABA and Glutamate in the hDB and their roles in cardiovascular responses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the GABAergic system in the hDB is involved in the regulation of the cardiovascular responses and this system is dependent on the activation on the local glutaminergic neurons.
the GABAergic system of the hDB is tonically inhibiting the glutaminergic system.
the interaction of GABA and Glutamate in the hDB is a complex system that is involved in the control of the cardiovascular system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the glutamatergic neurons of hDB are involved in the cardiovascular regulation.
the hDB plays an important role in the regulation of blood pressure and heart rates through the GABAergic-glutaminergic interaction.
, the glutaminergic system in the hDB is tonically activated and GABAergic neurons are tonically inhibiting the glutaminergic ones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GABAergic system is an inhibitory system and it is involved in the regulation of cardiovascular system.
, in the hDB of anesthetized rats, the GABA(A) receptors play a major role in the cardiovascular effects of the local glutamatergic neurons.
GABA and glutamine interact in the hDB to produce the cardiovascular responses.
